extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, historians, librarians, patent attorneys, and examiners seeking bibliographic/index information for U.S. patents issued in 1877
extracted.subtask_description: Alphabetical index listing patentees, residences, invention titles, issue dates, monthly volume and Official Gazette numbers for patents issued by the United States Patent Office in 1877. Serves as a bibliographic/reference dataset to locate original patent documents.
